parameters.query:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.priority), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT rule_group, rule_name, rule_content, applies_to_intents, validation_hint, severity, priority
      FROM public.ai_ducklake_agent_rules
      WHERE agent_version = 'v2.0-ducklake-query-generator-offline-poc'
        AND is_active = true
      ORDER BY priority ASC
    ) r
  ) AS regras,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.priority, e.entity_type, e.user_term), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT entity_type, user_term, canonical_value, target_table, target_column, sql_filter_hint, business_rule, priority
      FROM public.ai_ducklake_entity_aliases
      WHERE agent_version = 'v2.0-ducklake-query-generator-offline-poc'
        AND is_active = true
      ORDER BY priority ASC, entity_type ASC, user_term ASC
    ) e
  ) AS entidades,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.sort_order), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT dre_code, nivel_1_bi, business_description, sign_convention, category, is_revenue, is_deduction, is_cost, is_opex, is_financial_result, sql_filter_hint, sort_order
      FROM public.ai_ducklake_dre_mapping
      WHERE agent_version = 'v2.0-ducklake-query-generator-offline-poc'
        AND is_active = true
      ORDER BY sort_order ASC
    ) d
  ) AS dre,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.priority), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT intent_name, pattern_name, business_question_examples, required_tables, required_rules, sql_pattern, notes, priority
      FROM public.ai_ducklake_sql_patterns
      WHERE agent_version = 'v2.0-ducklake-query-generator-offline-poc'
        AND is_active = true
      ORDER BY priority ASC
    ) p
  ) AS padroes,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.priority), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (
      SELECT table_name, schema_name, table_type, description, grain, primary_key, key_columns, metric_columns, date_columns, join_rules, ai_hint, priority
      FROM public.ai_ducklake_table_catalog
      WHERE agent_version = 'v2.0-ducklake-query-generator-offline-poc'
        AND is_allowed = true
      ORDER BY priority ASC
    ) t
  ) AS catalogo;

nodes.name: Code - Montar Prompt SQL DuckLake Offline

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  question_original,
  question_normalized,
  question_hash,
  intent,
  period_key,
  sql_generated,
  sql_hash,
  validation_status,
  validation_version,
  rules_version,
  schema_version,
  prompt_version,
  cleaner_version,
  hit_count,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  last_hit_at,
  is_active
FROM public.sql_generation_cache
WHERE is_active = true
  AND question_hash = '{{ $json.question_hash }}'
  AND COALESCE(intent, '') = COALESCE('{{ $json.intent }}', '')
  AND COALESCE(period_key, '') = COALESCE('{{ $json.period_key }}', '')
  AND COALESCE(rules_version, '') = COALESCE('{{ $json.rules_version }}', '')
  AND COALESCE(schema_version, '') = COALESCE('{{ $json.schema_version_cache }}', '')
  AND COALESCE(prompt_version, '') = COALESCE('{{ $json.prompt_version }}', '')
  AND validation_status IN ('approved', 'aprovado')
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE public.sql_generation_cache
SET
  hit_count = COALESCE(hit_count, 0) + 1,
  last_hit_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.cache.cache_id }}'
RETURNING id, hit_count, last_hit_at;

INSERT INTO public.sql_generation_cache (
  question_original,
  question_normalized,
  question_hash,
  intent,
  period_key,
  sql_generated,
  sql_hash,
  validation_status,
  validation_version,
  rules_version,
  schema_version,
  prompt_version,
  cleaner_version,
  hit_count,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  is_active
)
VALUES (
  '{{ String($json.question_original || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.question_normalized || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.question_hash }}',
  '{{ String($json.intent || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.period_key || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  $sqlcache${{ String($json.sql_generated || "").replaceAll("$sqlcache$", "$sql_cache$") }}$sqlcache$,
  '{{ $json.sql_hash }}',
  'approved',
  '{{ String($json.validation_version || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.rules_version || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.schema_version_cache || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.prompt_version || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.cleaner_version || "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  0,
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  true
)
ON CONFLICT (
  question_hash,
  intent,
  period_key,
  rules_version,
  schema_version,
  prompt_version
)
DO UPDATE SET
  sql_generated = EXCLUDED.sql_generated,
  sql_hash = EXCLUDED.sql_hash,
  validation_status = 'approved',
  validation_version = EXCLUDED.validation_version,
  cleaner_version = EXCLUDED.cleaner_version,
  updated_at = NOW(),
  is_active = true
RETURNING
  id,
  hit_count,
  created_at,
  updated_at;

UPDATE public.sql_generation_cache
SET
  is_active = false,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.cache.cache_id }}'
RETURNING id, is_active, updated_at;

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sql_generation_cache (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  question_original TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_normalized TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_hash TEXT NOT NULL,

  intent TEXT,
  period_key TEXT,

  sql_generated TEXT NOT NULL,
  sql_hash TEXT NOT NULL,

  validation_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved',
  validation_version TEXT,
  rules_version TEXT,
  schema_version TEXT,
  prompt_version TEXT,
  cleaner_version TEXT,

  hit_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  last_hit_at TIMESTAMP,

  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,

  UNIQUE (
    question_hash,
    intent,
    period_key,
    rules_version,
    schema_version,
    prompt_version
  )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sql_generation_cache_lookup
ON public.sql_generation_cache (
  question_hash,
  intent,
  period_key,
  rules_version,
  schema_version,
  prompt_version,
  is_active
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sql_generation_cache_created_at
ON public.sql_generation_cache (created_at DESC);
